title: Screenshot and Photo Upload via Plain HTTP to Raw IP
description: Sensitive child device screenshots and activity photos are uploaded over unencrypted `http://` directly to a hardcoded public IPv4 address (`http://34.124.175.184:8080/upload`).
attack_vector: Passive network observers on ISP links, cellular towers, or local Wi-Fi capture multipart HTTP POST payloads in transit, reconstructing private screenshots of minor users in violation of UU PDP.
fix_rationale: Transmit all media uploads exclusively over HTTPS (`https://`) to a certificate-validated domain name with TLS 1.3 encryption.
